correctness.rationale: The weights telescope to (T^n x)_m=((m+n)/m)^(1/p)x_{m+n}. Each translated output dyadic interval meets at most two input dyadic blocks. Each source block has independent p-th power budget1, maximized by smallest available output index. For a=1 the max is n+1. For a>=4 a single block contributes <=1+n/a, two at most 2+n(1/a+1/(a+1))<=2+9n/20, strictly below candidate for n>=2 and below17/6 at n=1. For a=2 the two source coordinates cross a dyadic boundary iff n+3 is a power of 2; maxima 2+5n/6 exceed n+1 only for n=1,5, with exact 17/6,37/6. Uniqueness of winning output block and saturation of one or two distinct source budgets gives all norm-attaining unit vectors. Analytic inequalities prove all n,p; independent exact-rational n=1..201 across 18 block depths corroborated only finite cases.
